name: Ychthytonian
description: The Ychthytonians were a sentient species of four-armed beings native to the Ychthyton system. They were part of the galactic community by 0 ABY and were part of the New Republic by 14 ABY. One notable Ychthytonian was the bartender Bômlas, who worked in the asteroid belt Smuggler's Run, a hideout for hundreds of smugglers.
